## Change

What changed, and why? Link the task or decision.

## Evidence and checks

List the commands run and their results. For research work, link the run record or source passage. State what was not checked.

## Review checklist

- [ ] This stays within the agreed scope, or an approved change is linked.
- [ ] The prose follows the writing guide; technical terms, quotations, citations, values, and uncertainty are intact.
- [ ] The submitted proposal files are unchanged.
- [ ] No private keys, local histories, unauthorized uploads, or large raw artifacts are included.
- [ ] Relevant workspace and research tests pass; failures or skipped checks are explained.

For experiments or result claims, complete these too, or explain why they do not apply:

- [ ] Both methods use the same workload and accuracy rule, with valid reuse.
- [ ] Energy coverage, estimates, seeds, failures, retries, and uncertainty are recorded.
- [ ] Setup, training, query costs, and study electricity are not mixed or double counted.
- [ ] Claims and figures can be traced to source notes or run records.
